# Snapshots With the Right Referer

Version 2.6.2 fixes how the camera takes its still image: the request to the stream host now carries the headers the site expects.

## Cameras

- **The still image sends the Referer to the stream host.** When the camera took a snapshot from the live stream, it handed its Referer and User-Agent to ffmpeg in the wrong place, after the input, where ffmpeg treats them as output options. The playlist and segment requests reached the stream host without a Referer and with ffmpeg's own User-Agent. Both headers now come before the input, so ffmpeg sends them with every request for the snapshot, the way a browser on skylinewebcams.com does. _[#44]_

## If you already use the integration

Nothing to change. Your webcams keep working, and the card is unchanged apart from its version.
